name: io.github.mattoddie/crunch-mcp
title: Crunch Accounting (crunch-mcp)
description: Work with your Crunch Accounting books: expenses, receipts, invoices, clients, suppliers and banking

runtimeArguments.name: --volume
runtimeArguments.description: Docker volume for the saved login. Keep it: Crunch refresh tokens rotate, so the login is lost without it.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Serve MCP over stdio. The image serves HTTP by default.

environmentVariables.name: CRUNCH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The client ID Crunch gave you when it approved your API application.

environmentVariables.name: CRUNCH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Only for confidential clients, which Crunch issues a secret. Leave empty for a public client.

environmentVariables.name: CRUNCH_REDIRECT_URI
environmentVariables.description: Only if your API account has a redirect URI registered with Crunch. Empty means http://127.0.0.1:8976/callback.

environmentVariables.name: CRUNCH_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional refresh token to start from instead of logging in. Don't use it anywhere else afterwards.

environmentVariables.name: CRUNCH_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Allow creating and changing records, including issuing invoices. Off means read-only.

environmentVariables.name: CRUNCH_ALLOW_DELETES
environmentVariables.description: Also allow deleting records and removing payments. Needs CRUNCH_ALLOW_WRITES.

environmentVariables.name: CRUNCH_ALLOW_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Also allow emailing invoices and turning on payment reminders. Needs CRUNCH_ALLOW_WRITES.

environmentVariables.name: CRUNCH_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated toolsets to expose fewer tools, e.g. account,reference,expenses. Empty means all.

environmentVariables.name: CRUNCH_FILES_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional folder, inside the container, for receipts to attach and files to save. Mount it too. Empty turns it off.

environmentVariables.name: CRUNCH_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Optional audit log of every change: stderr, or a file path inside the container. Empty turns it off.
